title: Tenant-aware preflight prober and cost guard for version locks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Implement a tenant-aware preflight probing system that automatically runs a staged set of quality and cost checks whenever a model version is pinned in the catalog or by a customer. The prober must: 1) run a lightweight smoke test (synthetic prompts + latency check), 2) run targeted fidelity checks using tenant-weighted prompt samples, 3) produce a cost delta estimate per tenant for the proposed model/config change, 4) surface pass/fail and cost recommendations to the Console and trigger automatic rollback/fallback policies when thresholds are exceeded. Scope: catalog-level pins and customer tenant locks. Out-of-scope: full-scale retraining or large-scale corpus evaluation. Acceptance criteria: - For any pin event, the prober runs automatically within 5 minutes and reports results in Console. - Fidelity regressions (precision metrics) flagged when delta > 3% on tenant sample. - Estimated token cost change reported and flagged if > 10% for a tenant. - Rollout gating: block promotion to production unless preflight pass or explicit override with justification. - Cost guard prevents more than 2x estimated per-tenant spend without manual approval.
comments: 2026-02-15 - Aisha K: Initial scope write-up and success metrics added. Proposed tenant-weighted sampling instead of uniform sampling to avoid misrepresenting low-TTV customers.

2026-02-21 - Eng sync (Diego M): Will reuse existing eval-orchestration hooks (ENG-30217) but add tenant-priority queue and a budgeter to cap running evals per hour.

2026-02-24 - Decision: Use two-phase strategy: smoke -> tiered fidelity. Smoke runs must complete <60s for 95% of tenants; fidelity runs can be sampled asynchronously and return within 30m for non-blocking reports.
